what: Chevron at the end of pill buttons and text links (>) on hover, the stem attaches at that moment and it becomes an arrow (→) — the chevron stays put and only the stem appears (no transition). The grow type makes the stem grow from the left in .2s

options.look: grow — the stem grows from the left (default appears immediately)
options.--fx-dur: Growing length of the grow type (css variable), default .2s
options.--fx-ease: Curve of the grow type (css variable)
options.[data-fx-part=stem]: Stem path inside the chevron svg (required) — from the chevron’s left end to its right tip

use: See more

from.where: shared.css .mp-chev__stem (notification bar “See more” · header pill button · hero button · feature “Explore” · footer link)
